# Petrify: encase an enemy in stone. It cannot act, takes only 1 damage per hit,
# and the shell shatters for 4 damage when the spell ends.

PETRIFY_TURNS = 3
SHATTER_DAMAGE = 4
DAMAGE_CAP = 1


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    me = ctx.entity(caster)
    if me is None:
        return
    victim = ctx.entity_at(target)
    if victim is None or victim.faction == me.faction:
        ctx.log("There is no enemy there to turn to stone.")
        return
    if ctx.has_status(victim.id, "petrified"):
        ctx.log(f"The {victim.name} is already solid stone.")
        return
    ctx.apply_status(victim.id, "petrified", PETRIFY_TURNS, source=caster)


def on_petrified_apply(ctx, status):
    victim = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if victim is None:
        return
    name = "you" if victim.is_player else f"the {victim.name}"
    ctx.log(f"Grey stone creeps over {name} until only a boulder remains.")


def on_petrified_damaged(ctx, status, amount, source):
    if amount <= DAMAGE_CAP:
        return
    holder = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if holder is None or not holder.alive:
        return
    ctx.heal(status.holder, amount - DAMAGE_CAP)


def on_petrified_expire(ctx, status):
    victim = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if victim is None or not victim.alive:
        return
    ctx.log(f"The cracked shell bursts, showering the {victim.name} in shards!")
    ctx.damage(status.holder, SHATTER_DAMAGE, source=status.source)


define_status(
    id="petrified",
    name="Petrified",
    description="Turned to stone: cannot act and takes only 1 damage per hit. Shatters for 4 damage when it ends.",
    prevents_action=True,
    on_apply=on_petrified_apply,
    on_damaged=on_petrified_damaged,
    on_expire=on_petrified_expire,
    appearance="petrified_boulder",
)

design.name: Petrify
design.description: Encase an enemy in stone for 3 turns. It skips all its turns and takes only 1 damage per hit while petrified; when the spell ends the cracked shell bursts for 4 damage to that creature.
effects: The target enemy is petrified: it skips all of its turns for 3 turns and looks like a boulder.
While petrified, any damage the creature takes is reduced to 1.
When the petrify status expires, the stone shell shatters and deals 4 damage to that creature.

review.rationale: Petrify is close to fair, but a 3-turn lock with a 3-turn cooldown lets you re-stone the same monster forever, so the cooldown goes to 4 and recasting on a still-petrified target is blocked.

changes.reason: Duration 3 plus cooldown 3 allows near-continuous re-petrification; 4 guarantees the monster gets a turn.

changes.after: Recast on a petrified target fails, no refresh
changes.reason: Prevents permanent turn-skipping.

exploits_considered: Refreshing petrify before it expires for permanent lockdown
Using damage reduction to shield an enemy from allies' fire (minor, it's a downside)
Shatter damage stacking with Firebolt burst — within single-target budget (4 dmg at 4 mana)

# Turn a creature into an inert rock for a few turns; the stone shatters for damage.

DURATION = 3
SHATTER_DAMAGE = 3


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    victim = ctx.entity_at(target)
    if victim is None:
        ctx.log("The stone magic washes over empty ground.")
        return
    if ctx.has_status(victim.id, "petrified"):
        # Refresh cleanly instead of stacking (remove_status skips on_expire).
        ctx.remove_status(victim.id, "petrified")
        ctx.apply_status(victim.id, "petrified", DURATION, source=caster)
        ctx.log(f"The stone around the {victim.name} thickens anew.")
        return
    ctx.apply_status(victim.id, "petrified", DURATION, source=caster)


def on_petrified_apply(ctx, status):
    holder = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if holder is None:
        return
    who = "You are" if holder.is_player else f"The {holder.name} is"
    ctx.log(f"{who} encased in living stone!")


def on_petrified_expire(ctx, status):
    holder = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if holder is None or not holder.alive:
        return
    ctx.log("The stone cracks apart!")
    ctx.damage(status.holder, SHATTER_DAMAGE, source=status.source)


def on_petrified_death(ctx, status):
    ctx.log("The rock crumbles into rubble.")

design.name: Chain Lightning
design.description: A bolt of lightning strikes a target for 6 damage, then leaps to the nearest enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage, then leaps once more for 2 damage. Each enemy can only be struck once per cast.
effects: The primary target takes 6 lightning damage.

review.rationale: Chain Lightning was doing 12 damage across three enemies for 4 mana, above what a 4-mana spell should reach even on a short cooldown. I trimmed the links to 5/3/2 and pushed the cooldown to 3 so it stays a strong crowd-clearer without outclassing Firebolt.

changes.reason: Primary hit matched Firebolt's 5 damage at higher mana but with two free extra hits.
Total chain damage cut from 12 to 10 to fit the multi-target budget at 4 mana.
Prevents near-continuous multi-target burst given 1 mana per turn regen.
Keep the description text consistent with the new numbers.

exploits_considered: Total 12 damage for 4 mana far above the 2x mana single-target and 1x mana per creature area budgets
Chaining back to already-hit targets for infinite loops (already excluded)
Chaining onto slimelings created mid-cast (already excluded)

result.source:
# Chain Lightning: strikes an enemy, then arcs to nearby unhit enemies for less damage.

DAMAGES = [5, 3, 2]
JUMP_RADIUS = 3


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    me = ctx.entity(caster)
    if me is None:
        return
    victim = ctx.entity_at(target)
    if victim is None or victim.faction == me.faction:
        ctx.log("The lightning crackles and fades.")
        return

    hit = set()
    hit.add(caster)
    current = victim
    pos = victim.pos

    for index, amount in enumerate(DAMAGES):
        if current is None:
            break
        hit.add(current.id)
        pos = current.pos
        name = "you" if current.is_player else f"the {current.name}"
        if index == 0:
            ctx.log(f"Lightning strikes {name} for {amount} damage!")
        else:
            ctx.log(f"The arc leaps to {name} for {amount} damage!")
        ctx.damage(current.id, amount, source=caster)
        current = pick_next(ctx, me.faction, pos, hit)


def pick_next(ctx, faction, pos, hit):
    candidates = []
    for other in ctx.entities_in_radius(pos, JUMP_RADIUS):
        if other.id in hit or other.faction == faction:
            continue
        if not ctx.has_line_of_sight(pos, other.pos):
            continue
        candidates.append(other)
    if not candidates:
        return None
    best = min([c.pos.distance_to(pos) for c in candidates])
    closest = [c for c in candidates if c.pos.distance_to(pos) == best]
    return ctx.choice(closest)


define_spell(
    id="chain_lightning",
    name="Chain Lightning",
    description="A bolt strikes the target enemy for 5 damage, then leaps to the nearest other enemy within 3 tiles for 3, and once more for 2. Each creature is hit only once.",
    mana_cost=4,
    cooldown=2,
    target="entity",
    range=6,
    on_cast=on_cast,
)

# Summons a temporary allied spirit wolf on a nearby tile.

WOLF_FADE_TURNS = 5
SUMMON_RANGE = 4


def find_tile(ctx, caster, target):
    origin = ctx.entity(caster).pos
    if ctx.is_walkable(target) and ctx.has_line_of_sight(origin, target):
        return target
    best = None
    best_key = None
    for dx in range(-SUMMON_RANGE, SUMMON_RANGE + 1):
        for dy in range(-SUMMON_RANGE, SUMMON_RANGE + 1):
            pos = Pos(target.x + dx, target.y + dy)
            if origin.distance_to(pos) > SUMMON_RANGE:
                continue
            if not ctx.is_walkable(pos):
                continue
            if not ctx.has_line_of_sight(origin, pos):
                continue
            key = (target.distance_to(pos), pos.x, pos.y)
            if best_key is None or key < best_key:
                best_key = key
                best = pos
    return best


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    pos = find_tile(ctx, caster, target)
    if pos is None:
        ctx.log("The spirit world does not answer: no open ground nearby.")
        return
    wolf = ctx.spawn("spirit_wolf", pos, "player")
    if wolf is None:
        ctx.log("The spirit world does not answer: no open ground nearby.")
        return
    ctx.apply_status(wolf, "spirit_fading", WOLF_FADE_TURNS, source=caster)
    ctx.log("A spirit wolf steps out of the mist, howling at your foes.")


def on_fade_expire(ctx, status):
    wolf = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if wolf is None or not wolf.alive:
        return
    ctx.log("The spirit wolf fades back into the spirit world.")
    ctx.damage(wolf.id, wolf.max_hp + 1)


def wolf_act(ctx, me):
    wolf = ctx.entity(me)
    if wolf is None:
        return
    target = ctx.nearest_hostile(me, max_distance=8)
    if target is not None:
        if wolf.pos.distance_to(target.pos) == 1:
            ctx.attack(me, target.id)
        else:
            ctx.step_toward(me, target.pos)
        return
    player = ctx.player()
    if player is not None and player.alive:
        if wolf.pos.distance_to(player.pos) > 1:
            ctx.step_toward(me, player.pos)


define_status(
    id="spirit_fading",
    name="Fading",
    description="This spirit will return to the spirit world when the magic runs out.",
    on_expire=on_fade_expire,
)

    id="spirit_wolf",
    name="spirit wolf",
    description="A translucent wolf of mist that hunts alongside its summoner.",

        return

            ctx.log("The old spirit wolf fades away.")
            ctx.damage(other.id, other.hp + 1, source=caster)

        ctx.log("No room for the wolf there.")
        return
    ctx.apply_status(wolf, "fading", DURATION, source=caster)

        else:
            ctx.step_toward(me, target.pos)

    player = ctx.player()

design.name: Chain Lightning
design.description: Send a bolt of lightning at an enemy that arcs to two more nearby foes, weakening with each jump.
effects: Deals 6 damage to the initial target.
Jumps to the nearest enemy within 3 tiles of the previous target (not already hit), dealing 4 damage.
Jumps again to the nearest remaining enemy within 3 tiles of the second target, dealing 2 damage.

review.rationale: Hitting three enemies for 12 total damage on only 4 mana and a 2-turn cooldown is well above the multi-target damage budget for that cost — it out-damages Firebolt while also hitting extra targets almost for free.

changes.reason: Hitting up to three enemies needs a higher cost to stay within per-target damage budget.
Reduces spam frequency given the multi-target nature of the spell.
Cap first hit near single-target budget (2x mana) for the new cost.
Bring falloff damage in line with 1x mana per additional target.
Keep final jump damage minor, total damage across all three targets now ~9, matching budget for 5 mana/cd3.

exploits_considered: Cheap AoE-like chain damage far exceeding per-target budget (should be ~1x mana per target, here it's ~3x)
Low cooldown allows near-spam for burst clearing packs of monsters
Combo with Frost Nova to freeze then chain for guaranteed full hits

runs.idea: chain lightning that jumps between up to 3 enemies, weaker with each jump

result.notes: Chain jumps use the previous victim's remembered position (captured before damage) so a lethal hit still chains. Hit ids tracked in a set; hostiles determined by faction != caster's. Struck creatures get a 1-turn cosmetic 'arc_shocked' status with a crackling sprite.

# Chain Lightning: strikes a target and arcs to up to 2 more nearby enemies,
# weaker with each jump.

DAMAGES = [4, 3, 2]
JUMP_RADIUS = 3


def zap(ctx, caster, victim_id, amount):
    ctx.damage(victim_id, amount, source=caster)
    ctx.apply_status(victim_id, "arc_shocked", 1, source=caster)


def next_link(ctx, caster, origin, hit):
    me = ctx.entity(caster)
    if me is None:
        return None
    best = None
    best_dist = None
    for other in ctx.entities_in_radius(origin, JUMP_RADIUS):
        if other.id in hit or other.id == caster:
            continue
        if other.faction == me.faction:
            continue
        dist = origin.distance_to(other.pos)
        if best_dist is None or dist < best_dist:
            best = other
            best_dist = dist
    return best


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    me = ctx.entity(caster)
    if me is None:
        return
    victim = ctx.entity_at(target)
    if victim is None or victim.id == caster or victim.faction == me.faction:
        ctx.log("The lightning finds no enemy and fizzles out.")
        return

    hit = set()
    origin = victim.pos
    current = victim
    for index, amount in enumerate(DAMAGES):
        if current is None:
            ctx.log("The lightning has nowhere left to jump.")
            return
        hit.add(current.id)
        origin = current.pos
        if index == 0:
            ctx.log(f"Lightning cracks into the {current.name}!")
        else:
            ctx.log(f"The arc leaps to the {current.name}!")
        zap(ctx, caster, current.id, amount)
        if index + 1 < len(DAMAGES):
            current = next_link(ctx, caster, origin, hit)


def on_shock_apply(ctx, status):
    holder = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if holder is None:
        return
    ctx.log(f"Sparks crawl over the {holder.name}.")


define_status(
    id="arc_shocked",
    name="Shocked",
    description="Crackling with leftover electricity.",
    on_apply=on_shock_apply,
    appearance="arc_shocked",
)

# Summons a temporary spectral wolf ally that fights for the player for 5 turns.

WOLF_ID = "spirit_wolf_ally"
DURATION = 5


def fade_wolf(ctx, wolf_id, message):
    wolf = ctx.entity(wolf_id)
    if wolf is None or not wolf.alive:
        return
    ctx.remove_status(wolf_id, "spirit_bound")
    ctx.log(message)
    ctx.damage(wolf_id, wolf.hp + 100)


def find_spot(ctx, target):
    if ctx.is_walkable(target):
        return target
    if ctx.is_wall(target):
        return None
    options = [p for p in target.neighbors() if ctx.is_walkable(p)]
    if not options:
        return None
    return sorted(options, key=lambda p: (p.distance_to(target), p.x, p.y))[0]


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    for other in ctx.entities("player"):
        if other.kind == WOLF_ID:
            fade_wolf(ctx, other.id, "The old spirit wolf dissolves into mist.")

    spot = find_spot(ctx, target)
    if spot is None:
        ctx.log("There is no room for the spirit wolf to appear.")
        return

    wolf_id = ctx.spawn(WOLF_ID, spot, "player")
    if wolf_id is None:
        ctx.log("The spirit wolf cannot find a way into this world.")
        return
    ctx.apply_status(wolf_id, "spirit_bound", DURATION, source=caster)
    ctx.log("A spirit wolf howls and takes shape beside you!")


def on_bound_expire(ctx, status):
    fade_wolf(ctx, status.holder, "The spirit wolf fades away into mist.")


def act(ctx, me):
    wolf = ctx.entity(me)
    if wolf is None:
        return
    target = ctx.nearest_hostile(me, max_distance=8)
    if target is None:
        player = ctx.player()
        if player is not None and player.alive and wolf.pos.distance_to(player.pos) > 2:
            ctx.step_toward(me, player.pos)
        return
    if wolf.pos.distance_to(target.pos) == 1:
        ctx.attack(me, target.id)
    else:
        ctx.step_toward(me, target.pos)


define_status(
    id="spirit_bound",
    name="Spirit Bound",
    description="Held in this world for a short time before fading away.",
    on_expire=on_bound_expire,
)

# Summons a temporary allied spirit wolf.

WOLF_TURNS = 5


def find_spot(ctx, caster_pos, target):
    if ctx.is_walkable(target):
        return target
    options = [p for p in target.neighbors() if ctx.is_walkable(p)]
    options = sorted(options, key=lambda p: (p.distance_to(target), p.distance_to(caster_pos), p.x, p.y))
    if options:
        return options[0]
    near = [p for p in caster_pos.neighbors() if ctx.is_walkable(p)]
    if near:
        return sorted(near, key=lambda p: (p.x, p.y))[0]
    return None


def on_cast(ctx, caster, target):
    me = ctx.entity(caster)
    if me is None:
        return
    for other in ctx.entities():
        if other.kind == "spirit_wolf":
            ctx.log("The old spirit wolf fades away.")
            ctx.remove_status(other.id, "spectral_bond")
            ctx.damage(other.id, other.hp + 1, source=caster)
    spot = find_spot(ctx, me.pos, target)
    if spot is None:
        ctx.log("There is no room for the spirit wolf to appear.")
        return
    wolf = ctx.spawn("spirit_wolf", spot, "player")
    if wolf is None:
        ctx.log("There is no room for the spirit wolf to appear.")
        return
    ctx.apply_status(wolf, "spectral_bond", WOLF_TURNS, source=caster)
    ctx.log("A spirit wolf howls at your side!")


def on_bond_expire(ctx, status):
    wolf = ctx.entity(status.holder)
    if wolf is None:
        return
    ctx.damage(wolf.id, wolf.hp + 1, source=None)


def wolf_act(ctx, me):
    wolf = ctx.entity(me)
    if wolf is None:
        return
    foe = ctx.nearest_hostile(me, max_distance=10, require_line_of_sight=False)
    if foe is None:
        player = ctx.player()
        if player is not None and wolf.pos.distance_to(player.pos) > 2:
            ctx.step_toward(me, player.pos)
        return
    if wolf.pos.distance_to(foe.pos) == 1:
        ctx.attack(me, foe.id)
    else:
        ctx.step_toward(me, foe.pos)

    name="Spectral Bond",
    description="Bound to this world for a short time; fades away when it ends.",
    on_expire=on_bond_expire,
